title: WidenBot configuration
description: Configuration for one or more self-hosted WidenBot instances.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this JSON schema, enabling editor validation.

spotify.description: Optional. Use Spotify to look up tracks. Omit or leave blank to disable.

clientID.description: Spotify app client ID from the Spotify Developer Dashboard.

clientSecret.description: Spotify app client secret from the Spotify Developer Dashboard.

maxMemory.description: Required. Max JVM heap for EACH Lavalink server container, in -Xmx form (e.g. "512M", "1G", "2G"). Use no less than 512M, and no more than ~50% of the host's RAM (leave ~1G free for the OS and bot client). This applies per instance, so N servers use roughly N times this amount.

discordServers.description: List of Discord servers to run a WidenBot for.

label.description: Alphanumeric label used to distinguish containers and to view logs. Max length 112.

isEnabled.description: If false, this server is ignored during start / stop commands.

serverID.description: Unique ID of the Discord server. Right-click the server in Discord and select "Copy Server ID".

botToken.description: Bot token generated via the Discord Developer Portal.

requiredChannelID.description: Optional. Restrict bot commands to a specific channel. Omit or leave blank to disable.
